Then come Jack Flower, Shields, Allum, Ring D. Patience, Taylor, Rice, Shaw, R.

In the absence of D. and R. Patience abroad on Foreign service we knew things would be more difficult, but with Ginty unable to run owing to ankle trouble, and Saunders arriving late following a motor-cycle breakdown, Cadogan A.C. were certainly up against it!
Jim Ginty's Championship win also gave him the handicap, and the improved running of Taylor and R.
Then they came thick and fast, but to my surprise Tobin was our second man in the 7th position. Verney was 11th, R.
We were second to the local club in the team race and other of our club members to finish were:— 12, C. Abberton; 13, R.
